items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: He came and collected the money and came right back to New York. After you had subbed for him. ... I just started playing bass with Willy Bryant's band, so he called me to fill in for him while he went to New York.

ctx.x: Hanging out, uh-huh. Who were some of the first musicians you remember meeting?
Vic Dickenson, when he was with Blanche Calloway. When I was in high school, Wilson Meyers was the bass player with -- was the guitarist with the Seven
